label: malicious
summary: PowerShell was launched with a PowerSploit/Invoke-Mimikatz-family cmdlet manifest (Add-Persistence, Get-Keystrokes, Invoke-Mimikatz, Invoke-Shellcode, etc.) and Defender flagged/blocked it as Trojan:PowerShell/Mimikatz.A on win11-ep. The surrounding activity shows Atomic Red Team / Invoke-AtomicTest execution (C:\AtomicRedTeam, ArtConfig, ABSB AMSI-bypass hook) driven via encoded commands under labadmin, i.e. real credential-dumping tooling that a live attacker could use identically.

label: malicious
summary: The alert is part of an Atomic Red Team adversary-emulation run (Invoke-AtomicTest T1059.001) executed from C:\AtomicRedTeam on win11-ep; encoded PowerShell spawned by cmd/powershell is a real attack technique regardless of the operator, and the same session also ran certutil download, mshtml/rundll32 execution and EICAR drops. Deconfliction with any authorized test is out of scope for triage.

label: malicious
summary: A PowerShell one-liner invoked rundll32 with comsvcs.dll,MiniDump to dump LSASS memory to %TEMP%\lsass-comsvcs.dmp on WIN11-EP; Defender blocked it (Trojan:Win32/RundllLolBin.AF) and the operator then deleted the dump file. The parent process is an encoded PowerShell command importing C:\AtomicRedTeam\invoke-atomicredteam, i.e. adversary-emulation tooling that a real attacker could use identically, so it is treated as a true positive.
